meta.name: mix-compression
meta.description: Reduce mix output noise (5-15% token savings) by installing rtk filters that compress mix test/credo/dialyzer/compile output before it reaches Claude. Use when long mix output floods context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩 mix 输出以减少 token 消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Claude 处理 Elixir 项目且被大量 mix 输出淹没。
copy.tagline_en: Compress mix output to reduce token usage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with Elixir projects in Claude and get flooded by mix output.

howto.what: 安装 rtk 过滤器后，Claude 运行 mix 命令（如 mix test、mix credo）时，输出会被压缩：成功信息精简为一行，错误和警告保留，从而节省 5-15% 的 token 消耗。
howto.when: 当你长时间运行 mix 命令、调试循环多次执行 mix test/compile，或 dialyzer 输出过长时触发。

say.text: 帮我安装 rtk 过滤器，压缩 mix test 的输出。
say.note: Claude 会检测并安装 rtk，配置过滤器。

say.text: 对 mix compile 的输出进行过滤，减少冗余信息。
say.note: Claude 会配置 mix-compile 过滤器。

say.text: 为当前项目设置过滤 mix 输出的 rtk 工具。
say.note: Claude 会执行安装和验证步骤。

howto.what_en: After installing rtk filters, Claude compresses mix command outputs (e.g., mix test, mix credo): success lines become one-liners, errors/warnings preserved, saving 5-15% tokens per session.
howto.when_en: Triggered when long mix output floods context, e.g., during long sessions, debugging loops, or dialyzer-heavy projects.

say_en.text: Install rtk filters to compress mix test output.
say_en.note: Claude will detect and install rtk, configure filters.

say_en.text: Set up mix output compression for this project.
say_en.note: Claude will run installation and verification steps.

say_en.text: Filter mix compile output to reduce noise.
say_en.note: Claude will configure the mix-compile filter.
